ex.note: You seem to think the stuff for the stability and like the core work type stuff should be done with low weight and super controlled. No all muscles  should be trained with high intensity & weight

Each set is holding it with the cable machines cable aligned with the height of your hand in that 90 degree elbow angle. e.g: https://youtu.be/Y1Bp8d2EqAE?t=4 (pad not needed.) (make sure to be ISO!!)
Just get a bench and put it up to the cable machine. The cable machine at the gym is buns
https://www.youtube.com/shorts/tjoQWaWe1xg

Go DEEP. Dont control eccentric too much, just dont let it free fall basically. AND MAKE SURE TO CONTRACT/ COMPLETE THE concentric portion of the REP AS FAST AS POSSIBLE EACH TIME. (this goes for all)

always lockout elbow, at the bottom of each rep, exploding up at the bottom of each rep. always flex with maximum effort in all exercises. let shoulder go far behind body.
